title: Approval-triggered rerun: rerun-workflow-run.yml reads the PR head SHA from workflow_run.head_sha instead of an uploaded PR-number artifact or gh pr view
answers: Why does the approval rerun no longer upload a pr_number artifact?
How does the rerun workflow find the PR head commit for fork PRs?
Where is the PR head SHA used when rerunning failed GitHub Actions checks after approval?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/rerun.yml (job approved, fires on an approved review by an allowed bot or user) hands off via workflow_run to .github/workflows/rerun-workflow-run.yml, whose rerun step lists the github-actions check runs on the PR head commit with `gh api repos/$GH_REPO/commits/$HEAD_SHA/check-runs`.
Rule: Take the head commit from `github.event.workflow_run.head_sha` (passed as env HEAD_SHA in the rerun step). Do not reintroduce a PR-number artifact, `gh run download`, or `gh pr view` lookup; the trigger job in rerun.yml is payload-free and only echoes a message.
Constraints: `workflow_run.head_sha` is used because `pull_requests` can be empty for fork PRs. This applies to the approval-triggered rerun only, not to general CI workflows. The removed flow cost one artifact upload and two API calls per approval.
applies: Approval-triggered rerun of failed github-actions checks on a PR head SHA, including fork PRs.
says: Approval rerun no longer uploads a PR number artifact
